title: Pesquisador Fermentação Sr
description:
Na Amyris, somos pioneiros no uso de micróbios para transformar açúcares derivados de plantas em moléculas de alto desempenho em larga escala. Nossa plataforma abre acesso à química requintada e sofisticada encontrada em todos os sistemas vivos, levando a novas possibilidades de produtos, oportunidades de mercado e soluções de sustentabilidade. Com escala comprovada, estamos redefinindo o que a química renovável pode fazer.

Aqui na Amyris, somos um time de pessoas criativas e inovadoras. Nós valorizamos as relações saudáveis em diferentes perspectivas e nos empenhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, abrangendo diferentes raças, etnias, gêneros, religiões, pessoas com deficiências e comunidade LGBTQIA+.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades

  • Investigar de maneira aprofundada em literatura científica mecanismos que podem vir a gerar ganhos aos processos produtivos Amyris ou que auxiliem na resolução de problemas complexos durante o desenvolvimento dos processos, na manufatura ou nos diferentes CMOs;
  • Planejar experimentos em escala piloto e de bancada necessários para o desenvolvimento de processos de fermentação das diferentes moléculas do portfolio da companhia ou para troubleshooting de campanhas de produção para que atinjam os KPIs/qualidade planejados;
  • Utilizar softwares de análise estatística para analisar os dados de cada experimento e compará-los/gerar correlações com os dados disponíveis da manufatura ou de experimentos anteriores;
  • Preparar relatórios técnicos em língua portuguesa e inglesa compilando todas as metodologias, resultados e conclusões de cada um dos experimentos executados no PD;
  • Preparar documentos de transferência de tecnologia;
  • Preparar apresentações para os diferentes fóruns de discussão de resultados, inclusive com a matriz nos Estados Unidos;
  • Realizar treinamentos e suportes de campanhas de produção de acordo com a necessidade da empresa;
  • Preparar requisições de compras para materiais necessários ao desenvolvimento de processos. Organizar transportes de amostras e preparo de documentação necessária para análises externas.
  • Acompanhamento de auditorias de segurança, biossegurança, qualidade, processos, etc (conforme determinado pelo coordenador da área);
  • Liderar projetos estratégicos da companhia, quando houver demanda/oportunidade (PTL).
  • Treinar novos pesquisadores, engenheiros de processos ou técnicos de fermentação nos processos Amyris, nos conceitos importantes de cada projeto, para cada molécula;
  • Utilizar ferramentas avançadas de planejamento de experimentos, DOEs, DCCRs, PBs para avaliação de efeitos isolados e sinergias de variáveis de processo sob os resultados dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos no PD;
  • Ter uma visão sistêmica de processos envolvendo múltiplas áreas (Fermentação, DSP, Qualidade, Regulatórios, Segurança) estabelecendo conexões com as áreas de interface e avaliando os processos Amyris de forma ampla.

Requisitos

  • Graduação completa em: Química, Biologia, Engenharia Química, Engenharia de Alimentos, Engenharia de Bioprocessos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento em softwares de análise estatística de dados (JMP, Minitab, Statistica);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Office – Word/Excel/Powerpoint;
  • Experiência em redação de relatórios técnicos, transferências de tecnologia e análises de dados/análises estatísticas geradas a partir dos diferentes experimentos conduzidos na planta piloto.

Descrição da vaga: A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália. Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Procuramos um(a) Analista de Mercado/ BI JR para atuar no monitoramento e análise do mercado de tripas naturais bovinas. A posição integra a área de Business Intelligence da companhia, que é responsável pelas demandas de inteligência de mercado e, portanto, pela geração de análises e insights que orientam as decisões comerciais e estratégicas dos negócios.

  • Acompanhar preços, fluxos de exportação e importação, volumes e players do mercado, bem como dos mercados que utilizam tripas naturais como matéria-prima;
  • Fazer projeções de preços;
  • Monitorar indicadores econômicos e geopolíticos que impactam o negócio;
  • Pesquisar, tratar, estruturar e analisar bases de dados, tanto internos quanto de fontes externas (tais como consultorias de dados, sites oficiais dos países, associações representativas de setores etc.), utilizando Excel, Power BI, SQL e Python;
  • Mapear tendências e dados do mercado, contextualizá-los e apresentá-los em PowerPoint nas reuniões com o time comercial;
  • Criar relatórios e dashboards para apoio às decisões comerciais;

Sobre a Minerva Foods

Líder na exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul, a Minerva Foods é mais do que uma empresa global – somos uma comunidade de profissionais com o propósito de seguir “criando conexões entre pessoas, alimentos e natureza”. Atuamos em mais de 100 países, e contamos com unidades no Brasil, Paraguai, Argentina, Uruguai, Colômbia e plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália e no Chile. Com uma gestão sólida e estratégias inovadoras, buscamos constantemente os mercados mais promissores, modernizando nossas operações e oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade. Nossa logística integrada e diversificação geográfica garantem soluções que atendem às mais rigorosas demandas globais. Na Minerva Foods, sustentabilidade não é apenas um compromisso – é parte do nosso DNA. Adotamos práticas responsáveis que promovem a preservação ambiental, o bem-estar animal e a transparência em toda a cadeia de produção. Com iniciativas robustas de rastreabilidade, contribuímos para um futuro mais sustentável e transparente. Nosso impacto global é sustentado por 46 unidades industriais, 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais. Esses pilares nos permitem entregar produtos saudáveis e nutritivos para clientes em todo o mundo. description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role:

Are you passionate about connecting great talent with the right opportunities and eager to grow your career in Talent Acquisition? We are looking for a Junior Talent Acquisition Analyst to join our People team and support full‑cycle recruitment for tech and business roles within our Global Growth Group.

As part of a global organization, you will collaborate with teams across different countries — contributing to a high‑impact, candidate‑focused recruitment experience.

What you’ll do:

  • Manage end‑to‑end recruitment processes, with a focus on tech roles, ensuring a smooth and candidate‑centered experience.
  • Conduct intake meetings with hiring managers to align expectations, define role requirements, and understand team context.
  • Craft and publish job descriptions using Greenhouse and LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Screen resumes using keyword and competency criteria, identifying top talent efficiently.
  • Actively source candidates through hunting, Boolean strategies, networking, and market mapping.
  • Lead competency‑based and cultural‑fit interviews.
  • Coordinate and schedule technical interviews with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Provide structured, timely, and actionable feedback to candidates and hiring teams.
  • Manage offer processes, ensuring alignment between candidate needs and organizational guidelines.
  • Track recruitment pipelines, maintaining workflow quality, data accuracy, transparency, and clear communication with stakeholders.
  • Deliver weekly status reports to hiring managers, keeping them informed, aligned, and on track throughout the process.
  • Support continuous improvements by identifying opportunities to enhance processes, standards, and tools.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in recruitment, ideally with exposure to tech positions.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, high‑volume, or tech‑driven environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Excel for building reports and PowerPoint for presentations.
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), ideally Greenhouse.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining process quality and a strong candidate experience.
  • A proactive, organized, and detail‑oriented approach, with willingness to learn and grow.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

About The Team

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About The Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment

Work Model for this Role

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit

The Client Onboarding Department is responsible for conducting the process of identifying and verifying new customers. The team plays a key role in combating financial crime and terrorist financing.

To ensure that customers across business divisions are on‑boarded efficiently and in accordance with Group policies and procedures.

  • Ensure that the Front‑Office, Co‑ordination Team and Quality Control Teams are advised of case progress.
  • Issue client acceptance documentation and conduct account opening.
  • Assist on any other ad‑hoc reviews, projects or audits that the Onboarding department is required to carry out.

  • Ensure compliance with the company’s regulatory requirements.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment and knowledge of the risk and compliance requirements associated with this.

Competencies

Conduct Rules

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro.   • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. title: Retail Credit Risk Specialist
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end-to-end in the model development process, including, implementation,monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in-depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem-solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages)
  • Experience in developing or analyzing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment

title: Consultor (a) de Vendas - Loja de Móveis e Decoração - Campinas
description:
Principais Atividades:

Atuar em empresa líder em Móveis e Decoração de alto padrão na Região Metropolitana de Campinas/SP, reconhecida pela sua atuação há mais de 30 anos no mercado, com um show room com mais de 6 m² de exposição, equipe própria de montagem e entrega, decoradores e consultores de vendas especializados.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Atuar com vendas para loja de móveis e decoração de grande porte, tradicional e reconhecida em Campinas.
  2. Realizar atendimento ao cliente que entra em contato com a loja por meio de nossas redes sociais e site.
  3. Estabelecer relacionamento, fidelizar, fechar a venda online e presencial.
  4. Fornecer informações precisas sobre os produtos e serviços comercializados.
  5. Prospectar clientes de forma online.
  6. Tirar dúvidas dos clientes.
  7. Realizar a venda em ambiente online ou físico.
  8. Mostrar benefícios e vantagens dos produtos e serviços.
  9. Garantir que as metas sejam alcançadas.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência na área de vendas.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, atitude positiva e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma ágil e proativa.
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Boa comunicação e relação interpessoal.
  • Cordialidade e gentileza.
  • Habilidades básicas de matemática; pacote office, sistema de vendas interno da loja e interesse para receber capacitação.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana com folgas pré-definidas.

Observações:

Horário de trabalho: segunda-feira a sexta-feira, de 9:00 às 17:00 ou 11:00 às 19:00, sábado das 9:00 às 18:00 (todos os sábados). Domingo a combinar.

Local de Trabalho: Bairro Cambuí/Campinas - SP.

Salário: Mínimo garantido R$ 2.100 ou comissão 3% + 20% D.S.R (domingo remunerado).

Média salarial: acima de R$ 3.000,00 ou mais dependendo das vendas.

Benefícios: V.T e V.R 20 por dia = aproximadamente R$ 500,00.

Contratação: CLT.

title: Product Manager - Personalization
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user-centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision-making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*
